name: IDEXX Laboratories
description: IDEXX sells diagnostics to veterinarians. It places blood-and-urine analyzers in vet clinics at low cost and earns money on the tests run on them, the consumables (IDEXX VetLab consumables), and it runs its own reference laboratories that vets send samples to. A vet-practice software and imaging line ties clinics in. About 92 percent of revenue is the Companion Animal Group (dogs and cats); the rest is water testing, livestock and dairy testing and a small human point-of-care business. It is a veterinary-diagnostics company, not a medical-device maker in the ordinary sense, which is how its GICS box reads.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list does not show the industry group or industry, so those are null.

hq.note: One IDEXX Drive, Westbrook, ME 04092 (EDGAR business address)

employees.note: Approximately 11,000 regular full-time and part-time employees in about 34 countries (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Companion Animal Group (CAG)
businessLines.how: Razor-and-blade: analyzers placed in vet clinics (capital sales $200.2M) and then recurring consumable tests sold each time a vet runs one; plus samples sent to IDEXX reference labs and billed per test; plus software subscriptions. Recurring revenue was $3,407.2M, 86% of CAG.
businessLines.description: Diagnostics and information management for pet veterinarians.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income from operations, reported basis; FY2024 $1,034.5M

businessLines.name: Water
businessLines.how: Test kits sold to water utilities and labs, bought per test (recurring consumables).

businessLines.name: Livestock, Poultry and Dairy (LPD)
businessLines.how: Test kits and services sold to producers, dairies and government labs per test.
businessLines.description: Diagnostics for livestock and poultry health and milk quality.

businessLines.name: Other (human point-of-care diagnostics and out-licensing)
businessLines.how: Point-of-care analyzers and consumables sold to human hospitals and clinics, plus licensing income.

brands.name: VetConnect PLUS
brands.note: Cloud platform giving vets access to IDEXX results
